CTA detected in 9 analyzed content items (45.0%). Observed intent labels: {'book a table': 1, 'name the character': 1, 'reserve a table': 1, 'visit with a friend': 1, 'choose the full brit': 1, 'visit restaurant': 1, 'reserve_table': 2, 'make a reservation': 1}.
Promotional intent detected in 4 analyzed content items (20.0%). Observed promotion intent labels: {'saudi national day combo offer': 1, 'new menu launch': 2, 'new item launch': 1}.
Within analyzed visuals: menu visible in 10.0%, price visible in 5.0%, and offer messaging visible in 5.0% of items.
Logo was visually detected in 25.0% of analyzed items; recognizable branding was detected in 40.0%.
9 of the observed content items were matched as Reels (45.0% of the content window). 9 were enriched; average Reel views: 11409.56; transcript availability: 100.0%.
